description: Detects a scripting or LOLBin process retrieving a file from pixeldrain's direct-download API, matching the Q2 2026 phishing chain final installer.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/07/23/email-threat-landscape-q2-2026-trends-and-insights/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/23
tags:
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.t1102
  - attack.command_and_control
logsource:
  category: dns
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    query|contains: 'pixeldrain.com'
  process:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  condition: selection and process
level: high
2572.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.url="*pixeldrain.com/api/file/*" (Web.process="*cmd.exe" OR Web.process="*powershell.exe" OR Web.process="*pwsh.exe" OR Web.process="*curl.exe" OR Web.process="*certutil.exe" OR Web.process="*bitsadmin.exe" OR Web.process="*wscript.exe" OR Web.process="*cscript.exe" OR Web.process="*mshta.exe") by Web.dest, Web.src, Web.user, Web.url, Web.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2572.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(*pixeldrain.com* OR *PIXELDRAIN.COM*) @Image:(*\cmd.exe OR *\powershell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\curl.exe OR *\certutil.exe OR *\bitsadmin.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\mshta.exe)
2572.falcon:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/pixeldrain\.com/i
| ContextImageFileName=/(cmd|powershell|pwsh|curl|certutil|bitsadmin|wscript|cscript|mshta)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count())

2576.sent:
let AuthErrors = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where SyslogMessage has "[auth][error]"
    | summarize AuthErrorCount = count() by ErrWindow = bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer;
AppServiceHTTPLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ScStatus in (200, 302)
| where CsUriStem !startswith "/api/auth" and CsUriStem !startswith "/_next"
| summarize SuccessResponses = count(), SamplePaths = make_set(CsUriStem, 20) by ReqWindow = bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), CsHost
| join kind=inner AuthErrors on $left.ReqWindow == $right.ErrWindow

| sort by ReqWindow desc
2576.spl:
index=app_logs "[auth][error]"
| bin span=5m _time AS errWindow
| stats count as authErrors by errWindow, host
| join type=inner errWindow host [
    search index=web_logs (status=200 OR status=302)
    | search NOT uri_path="/api/auth/*" NOT uri_path="/_next/*"
    | bin span=5m _time AS errWindow
    | stats count as successResponses, values(uri_path) as samplePaths by errWindow, host
  ]
| where authErrors > 0 AND successResponses > 0
| sort - errWindow

description: Detects a Gitea Actions Artifacts V4 UploadArtifact/DownloadArtifact request whose artifactID query parameter is an abnormally long digit string, indicating the CVE-2026-58426 HMAC tuple-boundary forgery where taskID and attacker artifact id are concatenated.
references:
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-58426
  - https://advisories.gitlab.com/golang/code.gitea.io/gitea/CVE-2026-58426/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/22
tags:
  - attack.t1548.005
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-stem|contains:
      - 'UploadArtifact'
      - 'DownloadArtifact'
    cs-uri-query|re: 'artifactID=\d{12,}'
  condition: selection
level: high
2660.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where (Web.url="*UploadArtifact*" OR Web.url="*DownloadArtifact*") Web.url="*artifactID=*" by Web.src, Web.dest, Web.http_method, Web.url, Web.uri_query | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` | rex field=uri_query "artifactID=(?<artifactID>\d+)" | rex field=uri_query "taskID=(?<taskID>\d+)" | eval idlen=len(artifactID) | where idlen>=12 | table firstTime, lastTime, src, dest, http_method, taskID, artifactID, idlen, url | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime

description: Detects HTTP requests bearing an X-WEBAUTH-USER header from a source IP that is not the trusted loopback proxy, indicating direct identity injection against a Gitea instance with REVERSE_PROXY_TRUSTED_PROXIES = *.

    cs-headers|contains: 'X-WEBAUTH-USER'
  filter_loopback:
    src_ip:
      - '127.0.0.1'
      - '::1'
  condition: selection and not filter_loopback
level: high

description: Detects ServiceNow sandbox-escape / GlideRecord injection gadget strings (Packages.java.lang.Runtime.getRuntime, eval, javascript:, GlideRecord) in requests to the CVE-2026-6875 pre-auth sink /assessment_thanks.do.
references:
  - https://slcyber.io/research-center/smashing-the-servicenow-sandbox-pre-authentication-rce/
  - https://cybersecuritynews.com/poc-for-servicenow-sandbox-rce-vulnerability/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/21
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.execution
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_endpoint:
    cs-uri-stem|contains: '/assessment_thanks.do'
  selection_markers:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - 'Packages.'
      - 'java.lang'
      - 'getRuntime'
      - 'eval('
      - 'javascript:'
      - 'GlideRecord'
  condition: selection_endpoint and selection_markers
level: high
2722.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.http_user_agent) as http_user_agent values(Web.status) as status from datamodel=Web where Web.uri_path="*/assessment_thanks.do*" (Web.uri_query="*Packages.*" OR Web.uri_query="*java.lang*" OR Web.uri_query="*getRuntime*" OR Web.uri_query="*eval(*" OR Web.uri_query="*javascript:*" OR Web.uri_query="*GlideRecord*" OR Web.url="*Packages.java*" OR Web.url="*getRuntime*") by Web.src Web.dest Web.http_method Web.url Web.uri_query
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime

title: PowerShell Download-and-Execute From Cloudflare Tunnel C2
id: 8f2a1c7e-4d3b-4c9a-9e10-2b6f1a0d7c55
description: Detects powershell.exe downloading from a trycloudflare.com C2 and piping to Invoke-Expression, matching the bandcampro/Patriot-Bait botnet agent.
references:
    - https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/russian-speaking-hacker-uses-google.html
    - https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/07/16/jailbroken-google-gemini-cli-botnet/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/21
tags:
    - attack.t1059.001
    - attack.t1105
    - attack.t1071.001
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_img:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
    selection_c2:
        CommandLine|contains: 'trycloudflare.com'
    selection_exec:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'Invoke-Expression'
            - 'IEX'
            - 'DownloadString'
            - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
            - 'Invoke-RestMethod'

    condition: selection_img and selection_c2 and selection_exec
